mentions.name: trainradar
mentions.description: A high-speed train viewer web app that displays train data collected through web scraping, built with a React frontend and a FastAPI backend using PostgreSQL and OAuth2. It also serves as a personal learning project for sharpening software development skills, covering scraping without being detected or banned and React state-management strategies to reduce UI re-renders.
mentions.source_excerpt:
my own high speed train viewer (trainradar) that i use to further develop my software development skills. so far i'm happy with it and its performance, and it has forced me to learn how to scrape without being detected/banned

i'm using react on the front, pretty interesting how it manages states in the frontend and how to come up with new strategies to not trigger so manny re-renders of the UI, and on the back i use fastapi with postgresql and oauth2
mentions.author: eljonny
